cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll talk about trying again, but I'll sit beside the door. Please move that chair; an exit needs to stay clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're confusing an available exit with a plan to use it. Knowing I can leave is what lets me sit down. Shall we begin?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can stop whenever you need to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I want to come home. Please treat that as a statement, not a moving arrangement. Ask me how it feels before you offer a key.

reason: Make A's qualified distinctions regulate a real hopeful disclosure; B's stopping agreement enables A to say the wish while controlling its consequences.
